title: SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Tax Technology Services Consultant II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Tax Technology Services Consultant II -**
**SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP)**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**The Team**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and help deliver technology-enabled tax solutions that support complex business transformation. It helps organizations align tax requirements with enterprise technology strategy. The team works across tax, business, and IT stakeholders to design and implement scalable SAP solutions that support compliance, reporting, and operational transformation. This role sits at the intersection of SAP development, tax process enablement, and emerging AI capabilities.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
In this role, you will contribute to SAP-based tax technology solutions that combine ABAP development, SAP S/4HANA capabilities, and emerging SAP Business AI tools. You will work across business and technology teams to build scalable solutions that support modern tax and legal requirements while improving quality, efficiency, and user experience.
  
  
As an SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) on the Tax Technology Services team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Design, build, and enhance SAP S/4HANA solutions using ABAP on HANA, RAP, Core Data Services (CDS), and OData services.
* Develop SAP Business AI, Joule, and AI agent use cases that support tax technology processes and business requirements.
* Design and develop RAG based applications, have experience on SAP Business AI portfolio including but not limited SAP Joule studio.
* Create and optimize RAP artifacts, CDS views, and service integrations to support Fiori-enabled applications and connected SAP and non-SAP environments.
* Apply development standards, performance tuning practices, and clean-core extensibility principles across solution design, coding, testing, and deployment.
* Support Agile delivery through technical documentation, unit testing, defect resolution, production support, and collaboration with cross-functional project teams.

**Location:**
Any Location
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 2-5 years of experience in SAP or SAP S/4HANA development
* Hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA or ABAP on HANA environments
* Experience building SAP Business AI applications or AI agents
* Experience with RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), including behavior definitions or implementations
* Experience with Core Data Services (CDS) views, annotations, or associations
* Experience exposing or supporting OData services in SAP environments

**Preferred:**

* Experience with HANA-optimized development practices, including SQL or CDS pushdown and query performance optimization
* Experience with modern ABAP development practices, including object-oriented ABAP and exception handling
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments
* SAP Business AI, Joule, or SAP business AI certification
* SAP certifications in ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, or SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)
* Experience with SAP tax touchpoints or tax-related SAP process design

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Manager - Manufacturing Intelligence
description:
**Use Your Power for Purpose**
At Pfizer, technology impacts everything we do. Our digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. By digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives. Your dedication and hard work will be instrumental in helping Pfizer achieve new milestones and make a positive impact on patients worldwide.
  
  
Role overview
  
  
The Manufacturing Intelligence and Technology Transformation (MITT) team within Pfizer’s Global Technology, Engineering and Launch organisation develops and deploys advanced manufacturing capabilities across Pfizer Global Supply. These capabilities include artificial intelligence and machine learning, soft sensors, advanced process control and agentic AI solutions.
  
  
The Data Science Manager will develop and implement advanced AI and process-modelling solutions in complex pharmaceutical manufacturing environments. This individual contributor role will focus on large language models, agentic systems, real-time soft sensors and advanced process control to generate actionable insights and support continuous improvement across manufacturing and quality operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Contribute technical expertise to high-impact analytics, modelling and optimisation projects.
* Identify high-value applications for advanced analytics, advanced process control, AI, machine learning, large language models, agentic AI and the Industrial Internet of Things.
* Design and deploy fit-for-purpose solutions for pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.
* Develop mathematical models, machine-learning systems and LLM-enabled agentic workflows, and support their implementation in GMP environments.
* Apply engineering principles, modelling tools and experimental methods to data-rich laboratory, pilot and manufacturing systems.
* Improve process understanding and enable real-time process monitoring and control.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders, communicate progress clearly and drive projects to timely completion.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Expert-level Python proficiency is a must
* Experience preparing and analysing large, real-world datasets, including structured time-series data containing thousands of variables is required
* Demonstrated experience applying AI methods—including LLMs, knowledge graphs and agentic architectures—to generate insights and support decision-making.
* Proven ability to develop autonomous agents or AI copilots for manufacturing or scientific workflows.
* Strong collaboration skills and experience working in diverse, cross-functional teams.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Adherence to best practice software engineering principles eg PEP8

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A PhD with at least 2-3 years experience or Masters with 5-6 years experience in engineering, mathematics, computer science, or related discipline.
* Expertise in first-principles modelling, including thermodynamics, reaction modelling and heat and mass transfer.
* Experience developing hybrid and practical process models for real-time applications.
* Experience with cloud-based development platforms such as AWS SageMaker.
* Familiarity with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake or Redshift and relational databases using SQL.
* Hands-on experience with deep learning and latent variable models for time-series monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated root-cause analysis.
* Experience integrating LLMs into real-time decision-support systems or user-facing agentic applications.
* Proficiency with visualisation and dashboard tools such as Streamlit, Plotly or Spotfire.

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid
  
  
Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
  
  
To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

title: Senior Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
****Role Summary****
We are looking for a hands-on Senior AI/ML Engineer to design, build, and deploy production-grade Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Agentic system design: Architect and build single- and multi-agent systems with planning, tool use, memory, reflection, and human-in-the-loop controls for complex business workflows.
* LLM implementation: Integrate and optimize LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, Llama, Mistral) via APIs
* RAG pipelines: Design retrieval-augmented generation solutions, including chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, and vector database management.
* Tool and integration layer: Implement function/tool calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to connect agents with enterprise systems, APIs, and data sources.
* Prompt and context engineering: Develop robust prompts, system instructions, structured outputs, and context-management strategies (including prompt caching) to maximize quality and cost efficiency.
* Evaluation and observability: Build evaluation frameworks (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing) and monitor agents for accuracy, latency, cost, hallucination, and drift.
* Leadership: Mentor junior engineers, conduct code and design reviews, contribute to reusable accelerators, and support pre-sales technical discussions and PoCs.

**Required Skills**

* 5-8 years of experience in AI/ML or software engineering, with at least 1 or 2 years building LLM/GenAI applications in production.
* Strong Python proficiency; experience with FastAPI/Flask, async programming, and clean, testable code.
* Hands-on experience with the Anthropic Claude API/SDK (messages, tool use, extended thinking, prompt caching, vision, batch processing) and at least one other LLM provider.
* Proven experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK.
* Working knowledge of MCP, tool/function calling, and multi-agent orchestration patterns (planner-executor, supervisor, router, reflection).
* Solid understanding of embeddings, vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma) and search relevance tuning.
* Experience with fine-tuning open-source models, and inference serving Ollama.
* Collaboration with data engineers, product owners, architects, and client teams.

**About The Team**
eClerx is a global leader in productized services, bringing together people, technology and domain expertise to amplify business results. Our mission is to set the benchmark for client service and success in our industry. Our vision is to be the innovation partner of choice for technology, data analytics and process management services. Since our inception in 2000, we've partnered with top companies across various industries, including financial services, telecommunications, retail, and high-tech. Our innovative solutions and domain expertise help businesses optimize operations, improve efficiency, and drive growth. With over 18,000 employees worldwide, eClerx is dedicated to delivering excellence through smart automation and data-driven insights. At eClerx, we believe in nurturing talent and providing hands-on experience.
  
  
eClerx is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, per applicable law.

* Build and maintain backend AI services and APIs using Python, with Java-based backend development wherever required.
* Integrate LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and open-source models into enterprise applications.
* Design and optimize prompt templates, system prompts, structured-output schemas, and function-calling workflows.
* Implement end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document chunking, embeddings, vector store integration, retrieval optimization, and response grounding.
* Develop AI agents and tool-calling workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Build evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, and regression test suites to measure LLM accuracy, hallucination rates, response quality, latency, and cost.
* Continuously improve prompt engineering and AI outputs through offline and online evaluations.
* Implement responsible AI and security controls, including prompt-injection protection, PII redaction, output filtering, rate limiting, audit logging, and access management.
* Integrate AI services with vulnerability scanners, ticketing platforms, SIEM solutions, monitoring tools, and other security infrastructure to enable automated workflows.
* Automate AI/ML operations activities such as data preparation, embedding refresh, evaluation runs, health checks, and monitoring using Python and Shell scripting.
* Test, debug, and optimize AI applications to ensure reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Maintain technical documentation, source code repositories, deployment artifacts, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with security, infrastructure, engineering, DevOps, and data teams to translate business requirements into practical AI-driven solutions.
* Apply infrastructure security principles and cloud security controls while designing and deploying AI services.
* Continuously explore emerging LLM models, frameworks, prompting techniques, and evaluation methodologies to improve solution quality and security posture.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Research Engineer — Agent Architectures (Coding & Autonomous Systems)
description:
Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building 
****aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems****

. While that is the vision, the mission to build safety aware autonomous system in the extreme near term. Our research work spans around areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI, Eurips etc. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai & remote), Paris, & London. 

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

The Role

Most of the variance in agent performance comes from the system around the model, not the model itself. This role researches that system. The coding agent is the primary testbed: it takes an objective, works on a repository, verifies its own changes, and produces a record of what it did. It runs inside a customer's network, usually with no internet egress, against codebases that are large, old, thinly tested and load-bearing. Small models under real latency and cost budgets are a target, not a fallback.

Three areas:

****Harness.****

Action space and tool surface design, context construction policy, where deterministic program analysis should replace model inference, control topology (single loop versus decomposition), verification design, and allocation of inference-time compute.

****Memory.****

Schemas for execution state held outside the context window, compaction policy and what it destroys, retrieval under closed-world constraints, and whether an agent measurably improves on a repository over time.

****Evals.****

Task construction from real repository history with executable verification, scoring partially-checkable long-horizon work, variance and contamination control, and failure taxonomies that attribute a failure to a component.

The work is controlled experiments on architecture, not prompt tuning: isolate a failure from eval traces, form a hypothesis about the responsible component, change it, ablate it, and establish whether the gain holds across repositories and model sizes. Outputs are papers, benchmarks and released tooling where we can publish, and shipped architecture where we cannot.

You will work directly with our alignment and interpretability researchers on post-training, behavioral evaluation, and reading what an agent actually did rather than what its trace claims.

What We Are Looking For

Research judgment with systems depth. You should be able to isolate a failure, design the experiment that tests your explanation of it, build what the experiment needs, and tell the difference between a real gain and an artifact of your setup.

****Agentic systems.****

Two or more years building agents that ran against real workloads, not demos. Working knowledge of the current landscape (ReAct-style agents, LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, the current generation of coding agents) and a specific account of where each stops working. Experience with tool-use protocols and orchestration under partial failure, retries, timeouts and non-idempotent actions.

****Evaluation.****

You have built an eval dataset or harness that other people then used. Comfortable with SWE-bench-class benchmarks and their construction, containerised task execution at scale, statistical treatment of noisy multi-run results, and pass@k, best-of-N and majority-vote scoring and their failure cases.

****Code intelligence and program analysis.****

ASTs and tree-sitter, static and dataflow analysis, symbol indexing and code search, call graph and dependency resolution, codemods and automated migration tooling. You should be able to build a repository-scale index and defend its design.

****Backend and infrastructure.****

Advanced Python. Sandboxing and containerisation (Docker, gVisor, Firecracker or equivalent), distributed execution of thousands of parallel trials, artifact and dependency management, and on-premise or air-gapped deployment. Experiments that cannot be run at volume are not useful here.

****Observability.****

Distributed tracing, structured logging, OpenTelemetry, and the replay and inspection tooling that makes a non-deterministic system debuggable end to end.

****Model side.****

You do not need to be a training specialist, but you should be fluent in post-training methods (SFT, DPO, RL for agents), distillation, inference-time scaling, and quantisation and serving trade-offs at small parameter counts. You should have a view on where architecture ends and the model begins.

You treat performance, reliability, cost, safety and interpretability as one connected set of constraints, and you make reasonable calls when the problem is loosely specified and ownership is assumed rather than assigned.

Qualifications

* Five or more years in research engineering, systems, or ML infrastructure, with at least two on agentic or LLM-based systems. A PhD in ML, PL, systems or a related field counts toward this, as does equivalent industrial research work.
* A public record we can read: first-author publications at ML or systems venues, a maintained open-source project, a benchmark, or a substantial technical writeup. We weigh a well-argued repository as heavily as a paper.
* Demonstrated ownership of a system from design through production behavior.
  
  

Useful but not required: developer tooling or IDE internals, language servers and LSP, refactoring engines, compiler work, large monorepo or legacy modernisation programs, RL infrastructure, and alignment, interpretability or safety tooling in production.

We publish. We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric

title: ML Research Scientist
description:
**ABOUT PARAMAIQ & NYAAYOS**

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. India runs one of the largest judicial systems on earth: more than 55 million pending cases and one of the largest legal workforces anywhere. Yet legal expertise stays concentrated in a handful of senior counsel and metro firms. For a litigant in a district court, often arguing in a regional language, the outcome can turn on who they can afford. NyaayOS turns the primary sources of Indian law (the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, the BNSS and BSA, decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, statutes, and gazettes) into a reasoning layer any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes, so the bottleneck shifts from access back to advocacy. We give an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading

firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them.

Generating text is the easy part. The hard part is making sure every sentence we put in front of a lawyer rests on real, currently valid authority. That is the problem you own. You own how NyaayOS represents legal knowledge, and how it finds and verifies the law behind an answer. Indian law is vast, cross-referenced, and always moving statutes get amended, judgments get

overruled, positions shift. Turning that into something a machine can search, reason over, and stan behind is the core research problem of the company. You settle it with experiments against a legal eval set you build with our in-house lawyer, not with intuition. The work ships into a product lawyers rely on, and it is judged there.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* How we represent a large, changing body of law so a machine can reason over it and know what is currently authoritative.
* How we retrieve the right law with precision, where the answer can turn on a single fact, provision, or jurisdiction.
* How we verify that an answer is grounded in a real source that is still good law and catch it when it isn't.
* The legal eval set as the source of truth. You design the benchmarks and you own the number.
* The research direction. On a small team, you frame the problem, run the experiment, and make the call.

**THE HARD PROBLEMS YOU'LL TAKE ON**

* Representing law that changes under you. An authority that governs today can be overruled
* tomorrow, and the representation must know the difference.
* Proving groundedness at scale. A fluent answer citing a real sounding but wrong or dead authority is worse than no answer. Verifying grounding reliably is unsolved in this domain.
* Defining "correct" where experts disagree. Before you can measure a system, you must build ground truth in a field where correctness is argued, not given.

**WHAT WE LOOK FOR**

* Strong command of modern retrieval and representation: dense and sparse embeddings, vector
* and lexical search, rerankers, and when each win. You can build and evaluate a retrieval system end to end.
* Hands-on at the model layer for RAG and reasoning: prompting, structured extraction, and using
* LLMs as components of a larger system.
* Knowledge representation in practice: knowledge graphs, entity and relationship modelling, and
* using structure inside search and reasoning.
* Eval-driven for real: you design benchmarks, build datasets, and measure factuality and
* groundedness, not just offline accuracy.
* Comfortable where learned models meet symbolic or rule-based logic.
* Strong Python and rigorous experiment design, and you write clearly enough that an engineer can build from your spec.

**BONUS POINTS**

* A high-stakes domain where being wrong has real consequences: legal, medical, financial.
* Indian law, or Indian-language NLP.
* Information extraction and NER from messy documents.

title: AI Agent Engineer Intern
description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe AI systems for real-world deployment. Our work spans agentic AI, alignment, interpretability, evaluation systems, enterprise AI, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and enterprise data.

We build AI systems where transparency, auditability, robustness, and controllability are first-class constraints. Our environment is fast-moving, research-driven, and highly hands-on. We value people who bring open ideas, take ownership, and turn ambiguity into meaningful outcomes.

The Role

We are looking for
****AI Agent Interns****

to work on high-impact agentic AI problems across applied, research, and product directions.

This is not a narrow internship focused on building small internal bots. You will work on real agentic systems, evaluation infrastructure, enterprise use cases, research prototypes, and product tooling that can shape how AI agents are built, tested, aligned, and deployed.

Depending on your interests and strengths, you may contribute across one or more of three tracks:

1. Applied Agentic AI

On the applied side, you will work on high-impact enterprise agentic use cases. This may involve building agents that reason over complex workflows, interact with tools and data systems, execute multi-step processes, evaluate outcomes, and operate reliably in real-world environments.

Example work may include enterprise workflow agents, agents over structured or proprietary data, human-in-the-loop agent systems, decision-support agents, and applied prototypes that can evolve into production-grade components.

Success in this track means building useful, reliable, and high-value agentic systems that solve real enterprise problems.

2. Agent R&D and Evaluation

On the R&D side, you will work on new ideas in agent architecture, harness design, evaluations, long-horizon reasoning, alignment, and interpretability.

This may include building new agent harnesses, designing evaluation frameworks, studying agent failure modes, benchmarking tool use and planning, or contributing to research papers, technical reports, and reusable research infrastructure.

Success in this track means producing research-quality insights, evaluation systems, benchmarks, or technical contributions that improve how agentic systems are understood and assessed.

3. Product and Tooling Agents

On the product and tooling side, you will help build agents that improve how researchers, engineers, and users interact with Lexsi systems.

This may include an
****AlignTune Agent****

for alignment workflows, AI Scientist-style agents for hypothesis generation and experiment execution, tools for evaluating and debugging agents, or product prototypes that turn research capabilities into usable workflows.

Success in this track means building tools that compound the productivity of researchers, engineers, or enterprise users.

Responsibilities

You will explore open-ended agentic AI problems and convert promising ideas into working prototypes, experiments, research artifacts, or product capabilities. You may build applied agents, design evaluations, create harnesses, experiment with planning and memory architectures, analyze failures, document findings, and collaborate with research, engineering, and product teams.

The expected outcome may be a production-grade applied component, a research contribution, a paper, a benchmark, an internal tool, or a product prototype.

Requirements

We are looking for candidates with strong programming skills, preferably in Python, hands-on experience with LLMs or AI systems, and a strong interest in agents, evaluation, alignment, interpretability, or enterprise AI.

You should be comfortable working on ambiguous problems, building prototypes quickly, reading papers or technical material, documenting findings clearly, and independently identifying high-value directions.

Bonus signals include experience with agent frameworks, long-horizon agents, evaluation pipelines, research projects, open-source tools, backend systems, enterprise data, or AI safety and interpretability.

Our Culture

We move quickly and value substance over polish. This internship is for people who want to work near the frontier of agentic AI, bring original ideas, build seriously, test honestly, and create work that matters.

title: MS - FDL - Senior Manager - AI Architect
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Manager – AI Architect**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – AI Architect to lead the strategy, architecture, and governance of enterprise AI solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines AI/ML architecture, technical leadership, and people management, translating business needs into secure, scalable, and responsible AI solutions. The ideal candidate will integrate predictive machine learning, generative AI, and appropriately controlled agentic workflows with enterprise applications and data to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will own AI architecture quality and technology roadmaps across engagements, lead architects and technical specialists, and partner with data science, engineering, product, security, risk, and business teams to guide solutions from discovery through production adoption and measurable value realization.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**AI Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Define the AI architecture strategy and roadmap, aligning prioritized use cases with enterprise technology standards, data readiness, risk appetite, and business objectives.
* Lead discovery and feasibility assessments; determine when rules, analytics, traditional ML, or generative AI are appropriate, and validate options through measurable proofs of concept.
* Design end-to-end AI architectures spanning data ingestion, feature or embedding pipelines, model training or adaptation, retrieval, inference, orchestration, APIs, and enterprise integration.
* Evaluate model providers, open-weight models, cloud AI services, and build-versus-buy options; balance quality, latency, scalability, cost, licensing, data residency, and vendor dependency.
* Establish reference architectures and design standards for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model serving, and agentic workflows, including permission-aware retrieval, tool authorization, and human approval for consequential actions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve complex AI design challenges; guide model selection, prompting, fine-tuning where justified, evaluation design, and integration with production systems.

**AI Delivery, Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across AI initiatives, defining acceptance criteria, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and stage gates from experimentation through production readiness.
* Partner with engineering and platform teams to establish MLOps and LLMOps practices, including versioned datasets, models and prompts, reproducible evaluation, deployment controls, and rollback.
* Define task-specific evaluation frameworks covering predictive performance, groundedness, retrieval quality, hallucination risk, robustness, fairness where relevant, latency, and cost; validate against representative test data and business baselines.
* Design production monitoring for data and model drift, output quality, reliability, usage, and inference spend; establish fallback behavior, incident response, and controlled model or provider updates.
* Embed responsible AI, privacy, security, and applicable compliance controls with risk and legal teams, including data provenance, audit trails, prompt-injection defenses, sensitive-data protection, and risk-based human oversight.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale an AI architecture team, coordinating data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, and application specialists across engagements; develop architects and technical leads.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance AI practice focused on rigorous experimentation, responsible innovation, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource planning, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with AI delivery demand and evolving technology needs.
* Mentor architects and technical specialists on AI design, evaluation rigor, production readiness, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen peer reviews and communities of practice.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance transformation leaders, product owners, and clients to identify AI opportunities, clarify process constraints, and define measurable success criteria.
* Present AI solution options, limitations, investment needs, and risk trade-offs to decision-makers; align expectations on automation boundaries, human review, and business value.
* Lead AI architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and demonstrations, including solution narratives, prototypes, estimates, data requirements, and implementation assumptions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, evaluation results, residual risks, adoption readiness, and realized business impact clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable AI Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable AI reference designs, evaluation suites, retrieval components, model integration patterns, and governance templates to accelerate consistent delivery.
* Assess emerging AI capabilities through structured experiments and business cases; scale only where evidence supports performance, operational feasibility, and acceptable risk.
* Enable finance-focused capabilities such as document intelligence, knowledge assistants, forecasting, and anomaly detection, with traceable outputs and controls appropriate to each use case.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across software engineering, data platforms, solution architecture, or AI/ML, including substantial experience architecting and deploying production AI/ML solutions.
* 5+ years of technical people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or engineering teams and delivering complex, cross-functional AI or data initiatives.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including managed AI services, deployment options, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Strong foundations in machine learning, model evaluation, and applied statistics, with practical expertise in generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and model adaptation trade-offs.
* Strong Python and software architecture skills, with experience in ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn), APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise application integration.
* Experience with MLOps and LLMOps, including experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation automation, CI/CD, model serving, observability, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of AI security and responsible AI, including data leakage, prompt injection, model limitations, explainability, fairness assessment, access controls, and human-in-the-loop design.

**AI Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide AI solutions from use-case discovery and feasibility assessment through architecture, evaluation, production deployment, and operational transition.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews, model and vendor evaluations, AI risk assessments, and production-readiness reviews across multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong skills in technical estimation, capacity planning, inference cost modeling, and total cost of ownership analysis, balancing model quality, latency, reliability, and business value.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise data and business processes; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) and associated control requirements is preferred.
* Experience applying AI/ML to finance transformation, ERP-connected workflows, document processing, forecasting, or enterprise analytics is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, practice development, and coaching skills, with the ability to lead architects and influence data science, engineering, and business teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and the ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations, and risks without overstating results.
* Ability to balance AI strategy with pragmatic implementation, challenge assumptions using evidence, and make sound decisions amid rapidly evolving technology.
* High ownership mindset focused on responsible AI adoption, production reliability, solution quality, and measurable business outcomes.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Agent Engineer - Evals and Harness
description:
Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems. While that is the vision, the mission is to build safety aware autonomous systems in the extreme near term. Our research work spans areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris, and London.

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

The Role

Our current sprint on building autonomous systems for complex problems, across software engineering, data science, and AI research, involves building the harness, execution substrate and evaluation system, and each is designed to run inside a customer's environment rather than ours.

This role sits underneath all three agents. The coding agent, the data science agent and the AI engineering agent look different from the outside, but they are the same system underneath: a loop that plans, acts, observes, recovers, and knows when to stop. You will build that shared layer, and the evaluation system that tells us whether any change to it made things better. Both halves matter equally. A harness we cannot measure is a harness we cannot improve.

****What you'll work on:****

Harness

* The core agent loop and its execution model, covering orchestration, concurrency, sub-agent coordination, cancellation, timeouts, checkpointing and resume.
* Context and state management for long-running tasks, including retention, compaction, and how an agent reasons over what it has already done.
* The shared tool protocol, its schemas, versioning, and the internal libraries every agent team builds against.
* The execution substrate. Sandboxed environments that are reproducible, snapshot-able and resource-bounded, and that behave identically for a repository task, a training run and a data analysis.
* Failure semantics. Retry policy, partial failure, idempotency, and the distinction between a recoverable error and a task that should stop and hand back.
* The trace schema every agent emits, which serves at once as our debugging surface, our training signal, and the audit record our customers keep.
  
  

Evals

* Task suites for each agent type, built from real work rather than synthetic benchmarks, and the infrastructure to run them at scale in parallel.
* Verifiers and scoring. Deterministic checks where the task allows it, model-graded rubrics where it does not, and calibration of the graders themselves.
* Regression gates that run on every harness change, with cost and latency accounted alongside quality.
* The statistics to say a result is real. Seeds, variance, pass@k, confidence, and knowing how many runs are needed before anyone claims an improvement.
* Turning observed production failures into permanent test cases.
* Tooling for how we work. Trace inspection, replay, and diffing one run against another.
  
  

You will work across all three agent teams and closely with our research team on evaluation design, post-training and interpretability of agent behavior.

What We Are Looking For

This is a systems and infrastructure role. Most of the difficulty here is concurrency, state and measurement, not prompting.

* Strong software engineering fundamentals and advanced Python. You have shipped and operated production services, not only written them.
* Concurrency and distributed systems. Async execution, worker pools and queues, retries and idempotency, backpressure, cancellation, and reasoning clearly about what happens when a step fails halfway through.
* Containers and sandboxing. Docker and OCI internals, resource isolation, reproducible environments, and an understanding of why a job that passes locally fails in a sandbox.
* Test and CI infrastructure. You have built test harnesses, run large suites in parallel, and dealt with flakiness as an engineering problem rather than an annoyance.
* Measurement literacy. Comfort with variance, sampling and significance, and healthy skepticism toward benchmark results including your own.
* Observability instincts. Distributed tracing, structured logging, and building the inspection tooling that makes non-deterministic systems debuggable.
* You debug systematically. You find out what actually happened rather than adjusting things until the symptom disappears.
* You are comfortable when problems are loosely specified and ownership is assumed rather than assigned.
* Experience with evaluation or benchmarking work for AI systems is a strong plus.
* Experience with agentic systems, LLM inference and serving, or developer tooling is a plus.
* Open source contributions we can read are a plus.
  
  

We are hiring several engineers for this team at a range of experience levels, including engineers early in their careers who have strong fundamentals and want to work on agents from the infrastructure side.

We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric.

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
**Who are we looking for?**

We are hiring a technical owner for our in-house AI products. This is a mid-layer engineering role. You will own the products we have already built, upgrade them, take them through to deployment, and stay close enough to users that the product actually gets adopted.

You are a technical resource first. You write, review, and ship. You understand the stack, the models, the infra, and the business problem well enough to make the right build decisions yourself.

**What you will own**

* In-house AI products: architecture, upgrades, quality, and release until deployment
* Technical execution for AI development happening inside the company
* Software and hardware infrastructure the products run on (hosting, servers, environments, usage, cost, reliability)
* Product adoption from a technical side: rollout, stability, usability, and feedback into the next build

**What will be your key responsibilities?**

**Build, upgrade, deploy**

* Own development and upgrades from design through testing to production
* Work in the codebase: architecture, AI tooling, integrations, and release quality
* Definition of done is deployment. Code that is written but not live is not done
* Keep the product stable: fewer regressions, less leftover WIP, faster path from change to live

**Technical ownership**

* Own the in-house AI product(s) as a builder: what we ship, how it is built, and whether it holds up in production
* Turn business problems into technical solutions, not a list of tickets for someone else
* Make build vs buy vs ignore calls on AI tools, models, and frameworks

**Infrastructure**

* Stay hands-on with hosting, servers, environments, usage, and cost
* Size infra to the product. Reliability and spend are part of the job, not a side conversation
* Keep product decisions and server reality aligned

**AI and technology**

* Stay current on AI tools, models, frameworks, and how the market is moving
* Recommend what we should adopt, what we should skip, and what we should build ourselves
* Keep the stack current without chasing every new tool

**Adoption and business lens**

* Treat adoption as a core outcome. A product that is live but unused has failed
* Support internal rollout with a product that is stable, fast, and easy to use in real workflows
* Measure usage and drop-off, then feed that back into what you build next
* Entrepreneurial mindset: ownership, speed, trade-offs, and whether this makes the business better

**What are the key requirements for the role?**

* 4-6yrs of strong technical base: architecture, APIs, data flow, models, and deployment. You can build, not only describe
* Hands-on with AI products and the current AI toolchain (LLMs, embeddings, agents, evaluation, orchestration)
* Working knowledge of software and hardware/infra: hosting, servers, environments, basic networking and usage
* Experience taking a product from build to live yourself, ideally an internal tool or AI product in a services / professional-firm environment
* Cloud hosting, cost optimisation, and production monitoring experience
* Product sense with a business lens: adoption, value, and cost, not only shipping features
* Entrepreneurial mindset: ownership, bias to action, comfort with incomplete information
* Clear communicator with engineers and with the business
* Comfort helping people move from old workflows onto a new product
* Mid-level: you can run this without being managed day to day

  familiarity with circuit analysis, activation patching, and feature visualization for neural network introspection.

  hands-on with Bayesian techniques, ensembles, or test-time augmentation.

  applying model compression to optimize size, latency, and memory footprint.

  crafting and evaluating few-shot, zero-shot, and chain-of-thought prompts; experience with RLHF workflows, reward modeling, and human-in-the-loop fine-tuning.

title: Forward Deployment Engineer
description:
**About QuilrAI**

QuilrAI is a seed-stage cybersecurity company building the AI-driven, human-centric security layer for the modern enterprise, combining data loss prevention, AI security, and behavioral (UEBA) capabilities into a single platform. We work through a select group of national and regional partners including Guide Point Security, WWT, Trace3, and others, and we’re formalizing a partner program built for the way security is actually bought today: consultative, technical, and partner led.

We’re small, moving fast, and building something the channel is genuinely excited about. This role is a rare chance to help build a channel program from the ground up alongside the VP of Channel & Alliances.

**The Role**

The Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE) works directly inside customer environments to deploy, adapt, and operationalize AI and Data security solutions. This role is deeply hands-on and customer-facing, focused on making AI, DLP, and Identity controls work under real-world constraints—often ahead of full product maturity. In addition to technical execution, the FDE plays a critical role in explaining architectural decisions, DLP limitations, and trade-offs to customer technical teams. You will combine hands-on deployment with clear technical storytelling and collaborative problem solving, helping customers understand not only what is being deployed, but why it works and where its boundaries are.

**What You Will Do**

• Deployment & Integration

· Deploy AI security solutions across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises customer environments.

· Integrate AI agents and workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, and agent orchestration patterns involving human and non-human identities.

· Integrate identity and access management solutions, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, OAuth, token enforcement, and service identities.

· Implement data protection and enforcement workflows, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP) inspection, policy enforcement, and audit logging.

• Hands-On Engineering & Troubleshooting

· Develop custom scripts, connectors, and workflows using Python and Docker to support AI security deployments.

· Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across AI pipelines, agent workflows, identity flows, authorization boundaries, data movement, and policy enforcement points.

· Design and implement practical workarounds to address missing features, product limitations, and customer-specific technical challenges.

· Maintain deployment artifacts, scripts, and configuration files in GitHub to ensure version control and consistency across deployments.

• Customer Workshops & Collaborative Problem Solving

· Participate in and co-lead technical workshops, architecture reviews, and whiteboarding sessions during customer deployments.

· Collaborate with customer engineers and architects to refine AI access paths, define identity trust boundaries, and validate data protection and enforcement strategies.

· Identify environmental constraints, integration dependencies, and deployment challenges early to drive technical alignment.

• Technical Communication, DLP & Customer Alignment

· Explain AI security architectures and deployment designs, demonstrating how AI workflows, identity controls, and data protection mechanisms work together.

· Communicate where security enforcement occurs, identify enforcement limitations, and highlight potential coverage gaps.

· Lead technical discussions on DLP detection and enforcement capabilities, including the structural limitations of traditional DLP in AI-driven and agent-based workflows.

· Address common misconceptions about DLP coverage and help customers understand risk trade-offs, enforcement gaps, and compensating controls without overstating security capabilities.

• Feedback & Continuous Improvement

· Document deployment learnings, edge cases, technical challenges, and failure modes encountered during customer implementations.

· Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams to influence the product roadmap, improve capabilities, and strengthen product reliability.

· Standardize successful deployment patterns, reusable configurations, and troubleshooting procedures to improve deployment efficiency across customer environments.

What We Are Looking For

**Required Qualification**

· Hands-on experience with AI/LLM systems, AI security architectures, and data protection mechanisms.

· Strong understanding of Data Loss Prevention (DLP), including data classification, content inspection, policy enforcement, real-world limitations, blind spots, and potential bypass scenarios.

· Solid knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM), including Single Sign-On (SSO), OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), token management, service identities, and policy engines.

· Proficiency in Python, Docker, and cloud-native technologies across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with familiarity in endpoint security and device trust integrations such as Microsoft Intune and Jamf Pro.

· Strong debugging, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and work directly with customers in high-stakes technical environments.

**Nice to have**

· Familiarity with AI agent frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangChain and LangGraph, including security considerations for agentic workflows.

· Experience integrating identity and access management solutions such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, OAuth/OIDC, and service identities.

· Knowledge of AI security risks, DLP enforcement mechanisms, data leakage prevention, prompt injection, and agent permission boundaries.

· Experience with cloud security, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, and infrastructure-as-code tools across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* · Experience conducting customer workshops, technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept deployments, and documenting reusable integration patterns and deployment best practices.

description:

.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.
* Experience reading or debugging code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments.
* Experience in system design or orchestration frameworks.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.

* Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact.

**About the job**
The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
  
  
As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer-facing teams.

title: Core Risk Governance – Technology & Risk, RQA, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
**Business Overview**
Managing risk is central to BlackRock’s investment process. Risk & Quantitative Analysis provides independent oversight of investment and enterprise risks and helps strengthen risk management across the firm.
  
  
Core Risk Governance team which sits in RQA India as part of Core Risk Management team, brings together risk governance, analytics and exception management capabilities to deliver scalable and resilient risk oversight across BlackRock’s investment risk platform.
  
  
The team focuses on making processes more consistent, controlled, automated, and easy to use through better data, reporting, analytics, and technology solutions.
  
  
Core Risk Management is extending its location strategy to Mumbai. This role will be the first senior hire supporting teams expansion in new location and will play a critical role in establishing the leadership, culture, operating discipline, and technical capability needed to build a successful Mumbai presence.
  
  
**Job Purpose / Background**
The Vice President, Core Risk Governance – Technology & Risk, will be the senior Core Risk Management leader based in Mumbai and a key member of the Core Risk Governance team.
  
  
This is a highly visible leadership role combining people management, technical delivery, risk expertise, and location build-out. The successful candidate will establish and lead the initial Mumbai team, create strong connectivity with the Gurgaon organization, and help build a cohesive, high-performing, and scalable multi-location operating model.
  
  
The role requires a seasoned leader with more than 10 years of experience managing teams, strong hands-on technical capabilities, and meaningful experience in risk management or financial services. The Vice President will lead the design and delivery of technology, data, analytics, reporting, automation, and AI-enabled solutions that strengthen risk governance and oversight.
  
  
The VP will combine strategic judgment with the ability to engage deeply in solution design and execution. The successful candidate will set high standards for talent, technology delivery, controls, operational resilience, and stakeholder outcomes while helping shape the long-term growth of Core Risk Management in Mumbai.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the senior Core Risk Management leader in Mumbai and establish a strong local presence aligned with the wider Gurgaon-based organization.
* Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team across technology, data, analytics, and risk-governance capabilities.
* Create an inclusive and connected team culture, ensuring strong collaboration, consistent standards, and effective knowledge sharing between Mumbai and Gurgaon.
* Support the phased development of the Mumbai location, including talent strategy, hiring, onboarding, capability building, workforce planning, and leadership development.
* Provide direct or matrix leadership to Mumbai-based analysts, associates, interns, and future hires, ensuring clear accountability and effective integration into their respective Core Risk Management teams.
* Help shape the Core Risk Governance technology, data, automation, and AI roadmap, translating business and risk priorities into scalable solutions.
* Lead the end-to-end delivery of technology and analytics initiatives from problem definition and solution design through testing, implementation, adoption, and production support.
* Provide strong technical leadership across Python, SQL, data engineering, cloud and enterprise data platforms, automation, analytics, application development, and AI-enabled workflows.
* Remain sufficiently hands-on to review solution architecture, challenge technical approaches, resolve complex delivery issues, and raise engineering and analytical standards.
* Partner with Risk, Investment, Data, Technology, Compliance, and Control teams to understand business requirements and deliver practical, controlled, and sustainable outcomes.
* Apply risk-management expertise to the development of reporting, analytics, controls, monitoring, and governance solutions that support investment-risk oversight and senior decision-making.
* Establish disciplined delivery standards covering software and product development lifecycles, testing, documentation, code quality, access management, issue tracking, release governance, and operational resilience.
* Build robust data-quality checks, monitoring, exception management, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, and escalation processes for risk analytics and AI-enabled applications.
* Ensure solutions are accurate, transparent, explainable, secure, user-focused, and aligned with relevant risk, data, technology, privacy, and control expectations.
* Assess emerging technologies and AI capabilities, balancing innovation and speed with reliability, safety, governance, and appropriate human oversight.
* Communicate priorities, risks, delivery progress, and key decisions clearly to senior stakeholders and leadership forums.
* Act as a role model for ownership, collaboration, sound judgment, technical excellence, and talent development.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline.
* More than 10 years of relevant experience across technology, data, analytics, risk management, investment management, or financial services.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams for at least 5 years, including people management, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and building leadership depth.
* Proven ability to establish or significantly scale a team, capability, or location while maintaining strong connectivity with a broader global or multi-location organization.
* Strong hands-on technical capability in Python, SQL, data engineering, cloud platforms, enterprise data solutions, automation, analytics, or application development.
* Experience designing and delivering complex technology, data, analytics, or AI-enabled solutions in a controlled production environment.
* Strong understanding of modern solution architecture, data pipelines, system integration, secure development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
* Meaningful experience in risk management, investment management, portfolio analytics, regulatory reporting, governance, controls, or a closely related financial-services discipline.
* Ability to connect technical design with risk context, business outcomes, user needs, and control requirements.
* Proven experience translating complex business and risk requirements into clear technical strategy, delivery priorities, and executable plans.
* Strong understanding of data governance, including ownership, data quality, lineage, reconciliation, metadata, access controls, and audit-ready documentation.
* Experience with artificial intelligence, large language models, agentic workflows, search, document intelligence, workflow automation, or AI governance is highly desirable.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge constructively, navigate ambiguity, and drive decisions across organizational boundaries.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex risk and technology topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Key Attributes**

* A senior people leader who can create followership, develop talent, and build a strong local culture from the ground up.
* A credible technical leader who can operate at both strategic and detailed levels.
* Strong risk judgment and an appreciation for independent oversight, governance, controls, and operational resilience.
* A builder’s mindset, with the ability to establish new capabilities and convert ambiguity into a clear operating model.
* High standards for quality, transparency, accountability, and execution.
* Strong ownership and the ability to lead through influence across teams, locations, and seniority levels.
* A collaborative and inclusive approach that strengthens connectivity between Mumbai, Gurgaon, and global partners.
* A pragmatic innovator who balances speed and ambition with safety, sustainability, and control.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Model Risk Analyst
description:
**Job Requirements**
About the Role
  
  
The
**Model Risk Analyst**
in the
**Model Risk Management (Market Risk)**
team under the
**Risk**
function is responsible for validating and enhancing the bank’s risk models. This includes improving the accuracy, coverage, and automation of model validation processes, and independently validating statistical and mathematical models, particularly for retail lending scorecards. The role also involves supporting the validation of wholesale and market risk models, ensuring robust risk management practices across the organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead initiatives to enhance the accuracy, granularity, and coverage of existing model validation processes.
* Develop tools to automate model validation workflows and improve process efficiency.
* Independently perform statistical and mathematical model development or validation, with a focus on retail lending scorecards.

Secondary Responsibilities
  
  

* Conduct validation of wholesale rating models, including:
* Quantitative and qualitative testing
* PD calibration
* Discriminatory power analysis
* Sensitivity analysis
* Rating migration testing
* Validate market risk models such as:
* Derivative and fixed income valuations
* Bootstrapping
* Value at Risk (VaR)
* Sensitivity and capital charge models
* Interest rate and foreign exchange simulations

What We Are Looking For
  
  
Education
  
  

* Graduation: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or related fields
* Post-graduation: Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field (preferred)

**Experience**

* Minimum 1 year of experience
* Relevant experience in model development or validation, particularly in retail lending, wholesale credit, or market risk models

Skills and Attributes
  
  

* Strong understanding of statistical and mathematical modeling techniques
* Proficiency in tools such as Python, R, SAS, or similar statistical software
* Familiarity with risk modeling frameworks and regulatory expectations
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple validation projects
* Strong communication skills to present findings and recommendations effectively

+ Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
+ Architect scalable cloud-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.

+ Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
+ Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.

+ Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
+ Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
+ Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
+ Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
+ Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
+ Implement release engineering practices including blue-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
+ Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.

+ Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
+ Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
+ Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud-native data services.
+ Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
+ Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service-level performance.
+ Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise-grade deployments.
+ Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk-sensitive environments.

+ Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
+ Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
+ Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.

* Business Development & GTM Initiatives

+ Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
+ Develop industry-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
+ Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.

* Program Governance & Delivery Excellence

+ Oversee end-to-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
+ Manage cross-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
+ Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.

* Practice Development & Team Leadership


+ Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
+ Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
+ Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.
