**Education:**

* B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).

**Core Technical Expertise (Hands-on Implementation Required):**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation & Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering & Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming & APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.
* Security & Governance: Familiarity with platform security, secrets management, policy controls, auditability, observability and support for Responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.

**AI and Data Science Certifications (Good to have):**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate / Azure DevOps Engineer / Azure Solutions Architect
* AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty / AWS DevOps Engineer / AWS Solutions Architect
* Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer / Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
* Additional: Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD), Terraform Associate, Databricks certifications, MLOps or cloud platform engineering certifications

* 10–13 years in cloud platform engineering, AI platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps or AI consulting (Big 4 / tech preferred).
* Proven track record leading enterprise AI platform implementations across BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi-cloud architecture programs.

* Exceptional technical storytelling for CxO audiences.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through working prototypes, architecture deep dives and platform transformation roadmaps.

title: Sr Eng Predictive Maintenance
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The Condition Monitoring Consultant will remotely monitor machinery health across multiple manufacturing sites and a variety of production and utilities equipment to improve asset reliability. The role involves analyzing data from condition monitoring and predictive maintenance platforms, identifying critical issues, generating actionable work orders, collaborating with Maintenance & Reliability and Planning & Scheduling teams, tracking program success, and reporting key metrics to stakeholders. This role requires you to operate in 1.30 pm to 10.30 pm.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Analyze data from condition monitoring technologies such as vibration, infrared, ultrasound, tribology, non-destructive testing, and motor circuit analysis to identify equipment issues and failure risks.
* Monitor equipment trends and conditions, and recommend corrective actions to reduce unplanned downtime, losses, and maintenance costs.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
AI Platform Engineer
  
  
**Department**
: CEFS IT (CRM&S - CRM)
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
CIB
  
  
**Experience Required**
: 7+ years in software engineering, AI engineering or related fields (or equivalent proven experience)
  
  
**Product:**
AI‑Native CRM Platforms
  
  
**Position Purpose**
Looking for a highly skilled candidate with 7+ years of experience to join our dynamic development team as an AI Platform Engineer. In this role, the candidate will architect and deploy autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agentic systems designed to automate complex CRM+ application features and orchestrate multi-step processes across enterprise data. This is an exceptional opportunity for a candidate to drive innovation in Agentic AI, RAG pipelines, and LLMOps within a high-scale, regulated corporate and institutional banking environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and deploy autonomous and semi‑autonomous AI agents that automate CRM workflows (sales assistance, support automation, lead qualification) and orchestrate multi‑step processes across enterprise data. Implement permission‑aware tool adapters, bounded autonomy, guard‑rails, escalation mechanisms and full audit‑logging to satisfy AML and security compliance
* Build production‑grade Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that ingest structured and unstructured data, perform chunking, embedding, hybrid search, semantic retrieval, metadata filtering and re‑ranking using vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate). Create reusable LLM abstraction layers that support multiple model providers and open‑weight models, with model routing, fall‑backs, rate‑limiting, cost‑tracking and token‑consumption optimization (caching, context‑window management)
* Design and implement robust state & memory management for autonomous agents—handle checkpointing, persistent context storage, efficient serialization/retrieval, and scalable memory‑access patterns to support long‑running, multi‑turn interactions while maintaining consistency and compliance.
* Develop AI‑powered CRM capabilities such as customer profiling, lead qualification, meeting preparation, interaction summarization, follow‑up generation and next‑best‑action recommendation. Build natural‑language interfaces that let users query customer information, generate insights and trigger workflows conversationally. Enable agents to retrieve context, update CRM records and execute authorized actions while integrating LLM reasoning with business‑rule engines and existing CRM processes
* Engineer scalable backend services and APIs (Python, FastAPI, async) that expose agent functionality, integrate with CRM systems, databases, email/calendar services, document repositories and external APIs. Implement reliable execution patterns – background jobs, message queues, retries, timeouts, idempotency and fault tolerance – and construct event‑driven architectures with Kafka or RabbitMQ.

Design and operate AI‑infrastructure and LLMOps pipelines: containerize services (Docker), orchestrate on‑prem or cloud‑native Kubernetes clusters (Helm, Argo CD GitOps), manage CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), and implement observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) together with model‑lifecycle tooling (MLflow, experiment tracking, model registry). Optimize latency, throughput, concurrency, resource utilization and inference cost; enforce access controls, tenant isolation, secrets management and audit trails.
  
  

* Provide technical leadership across product, engineering and compliance teams: own end‑to‑end architecture, prototype, productionise and maintain AI solutions; develop reusable frameworks and standards for agentic AI; conduct code and architecture reviews; mentor junior engineers; and continuously evaluate emerging agentic‑AI frameworks, models and deployment technologies for product relevance.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Proficiency in tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio)
* Familiarity with software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
* Familiarity with Oracle databases, Understanding schema, SQL
* Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
* Quick to learn and adapt
* Good Team player
* Someone who could have long-term commitment with the team and organization

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Agentic AI & Multi‑Agent Systems – Mastery of LangGraph / LangChain, tool‑calling, function‑calling, planning, task decomposition, state management, checkpointing, retries, human‑in‑the‑loop approval and performance metrics (completion rate, accuracy, latency, cost).
* LLM & RAG Engineering – End‑to‑end RAG pipeline design, context‑engineering, prompt optimization, grounding, hallucination mitigation, token‑window management, caching strategies and multi‑provider model routing.
* AI‑Powered CRM Capability Design – Ability to translate CRM domain expertise into intelligent features (profiling, scoring, summarization, recommendation) and embed LLM‑driven reasoning with rule‑engine and workflow automation.
* Backend & Integration Engineering – Delivery of high‑availability micro‑services (FastAPI/Node.js), event‑driven pipelines (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Avro/Schema Registry), secure API‑gateway configuration (Kong) and robust integration adapters that enforce permission models and idempotent behavior.
* Cloud‑Native & DevOps Practices – Deep experience with Docker, Kubernetes (multi‑namespace, Helm, Argo CD), CI/CD automation, Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform, Pulumi) and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki).
* Data & Retrieval Engineering – Proficiency with SQL/relational databases, vector‑search technologies, document processing, feature‑store patterns (Feast, Redis), data‑quality governance, schema evolution and caching.
* Machine‑Learning Foundations – Practical knowledge of scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, model training/evaluation, hyper‑parameter tuning and lifecycle management with MLflow.
* Security, Governance & Compliance – Implementation of permission‑aware tool execution, audit logging, model governance and adherence to AML, GDPR and internal risk‑management policies.
* Performance Measurement & Optimization – Definition and monitoring of agent/LLM metrics (accuracy, latency, cost), systematic A/B testing and optimization techniques (semantic caching, prompt caching, context compression).

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with vLLM, LoRA/QLoRA fine‑tuning, quantization and GPU‑based model serving behind firewalls.
* Hands‑on work with LLM evaluation and tracing platforms such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Phoenix, OpenTelemetry or comparable tools.
* Advanced agentic‑AI patterns: durable execution, Model‑Context Protocol (MCP), persistent agent memory and sophisticated human‑in‑the‑loop workflows.
* Proficiency with common ML libraries (scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) for rapid prototyping and model development.
* Knowledge‑graph expertise (Neo4j, Memgraph, TigerGraph, Amazon Neptune, JanusGraph) for large‑scale network analytics and entity resolution.
* Experience with large‑scale streaming and batch processing frameworks (Kafka, Spark, Flink, Delta Lake) and data‑pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow).
* Familiarity with multi‑tenant SaaS architecture, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, SSO and enterprise identity‑management solutions.
* Background in recommendation, ranking, lead‑scoring, customer segmentation, forecasting or churn‑prediction models for CRM intelligence.
* Infrastructure‑automation expertise (Terraform, Pulumi, GitOps, Helm, Argo CD) and sandbox quota management for GPU nodes.

**Specific Qualifications:**
NA
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Core Programming & Software Engineering – Python, FastAPI/Flask, asynchronous development, REST/GraphQL APIs, SQL/relational databases, Git version control, automated testing, CI/CD best practices.
* Agentic AI & LLM Engineering – LangGraph/LangChain, tool/function calling, state & memory management, planning, task decomposition, multi‑agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, vector‑DB integration, prompt engineering, cost & rate‑limit controls, model routing.
* Backend & Integration Engineering – High‑availability micro‑services (FastAPI/Node.js), event‑driven pipelines (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Avro/Schema Registry), API‑gateway configuration (Kong), rule‑engine integration (Drools or custom), secure credential handling, idempotent design.
* Cloud‑Native & DevOps – Docker, Kubernetes (multi‑namespace, Helm, Argo CD GitOps), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI), IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki), secrets management, tenant isolation.
* Data & Retrieval Engineering – Structured and semi‑structured data handling, document ingestion & processing, embedding generation, vector‑search (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate), feature‑store patterns (Feast, Redis), data lineage, quality and governance.
* Machine‑Learning Foundations – Scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, model training, evaluation, hyper‑parameter optimization, MLflow experiment tracking, model registry and artifact versioning.
* Collaboration & Problem‑Solving – Cross‑functional communication, stakeholder alignment, comprehensive documentation, mentorship, systematic troubleshooting and adaptability to regulated environments.

**Behavioral Skills**

title: Senior MLOps Engineer
description:
**Job Scope:**

As a Senior MLOps Engineer, you will own the operational backbone that takes AI models from experimentation to reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient production.

This role sits at the intersection of AI/ML, infrastructure, and DevOps. You will ensure models are reproducible, observable, secure, and continuously improving in real-world environments. You will work closely with AI researchers, ML engineers, infrastructure teams, and product leaders to operationalize AI at enterprise scale workflows.

**Experience:**

5–8 years of relevant experience in MLOps, ML Engineering, or AI Platform roles.

**Key Responsibilities:**

A. Model Deployment & Lifecycle Management

• Design and maintain robust pipelines for model training, validation, deployment, rollback, and versioning.

• Own end-to-end model lifecycle management across experimentation, staging, and production.

• Enable safe and repeatable promotion of models using CI/CD practices.

• Implement model registry and artifact management systems.

B. MLOps Infrastructure & Tooling

• Build and manage MLOps platforms using tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Ray, Airflow, or equivalent.

• Design scalable inference architectures for batch and real-time serving (REST, gRPC).

• Optimize GPU/CPU utilization for training and inference workloads.

• Collaborate with infra teams on Kubernetes-based model serving and orchestration.

C. Monitoring, Observability & Reliability

• Implement monitoring for model performance, drift, data quality, latency, and cost.

• Build alerting systems for model degradation and infrastructure failures.

• Enable explainability, logging, and traceability for AI outputs where required.

• Perform root-cause analysis for model or pipeline failures.

D. Data & Experimentation Pipelines

• Design reproducible data pipelines for training, validation, and inference.

• Ensure dataset versioning, lineage tracking, and schema enforcement.

• Support A/B testing, canary deployments, and controlled model experiments.

• Integrate feedback loops from production back into retraining workflows.

E. Security, Compliance & Governance

• Enforce security best practices for model access, secrets, and credentials.

• Ensure compliance with data privacy and AI governance standards (GDPR, SOC2, India DPDP Act).

• Build audit trails for model decisions in regulated or sensitive use cases.

• Partner with legal, security, and compliance teams on AI governance frameworks.

F. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement

• Work closely with AI/ML engineers to productionize research outputs.

• Collaborate with Product Managers to align model SLAs with business expectations.

• Enable developers and internal teams with reusable MLOps templates and tooling.

• Mentor junior MLOps or ML engineers through code reviews and best practices.

**Qualification:**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Engineering, or related field.

• 8 plus years of experience in MLOps, ML Engineering, or AI infrastructure roles.

• Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).

• Hands-on experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Ray, Airflow, or similar MLOps stacks.

• Experience with CI/CD for ML (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo, Jenkins).

• Strong experience deploying models on Kubernetes with GPU workloads

• Solid experience with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).

• Proven track record of deploying and maintaining AI models in production.

• Experience supporting AI systems at scale with real users and SLAs.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at
**sadhatrao@yotta.com**

Regards,

YOTTA

to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on-site client engagement.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**
As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
  
  
Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
  
  
Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
  
  
**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Search.
* Experience in solving complex technical search problems in terms of relevancy, scaling, performance fine-tuning, building a platform to handle high query throughputs and indexing throughput, benchmarking clusters to achieve optimal performance.
* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)
* Work Style: Comfortable working effectively in a highly distributed and remote team, spanning multiple global time zones.
* BS or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

**Bonus Points:**

* Familiarity/Experience in implementing similar products in Search Domain (Solr, Algolia, Open Search)
* Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications (e.g., Elastic Certified Analyst, Specializations) and/or specialization in machine learning, data analytics.
* Experience working closely with a pre-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).
* Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.

title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer (MLops)
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
General Mills, Digital and Technology India, is seeking a Lead ML Engineer to join our dynamic and innovative Global Data Science team. In this role, you are a critical member of the data science group focused on leading efforts in migrating ML-based solutions from concept to production-level operational excellence. You will lead initiatives building scalable, resilient, and automated solutions in GCP (Google Cloud Platform) to ensure that models deliver on organizational objectives.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Design, develop, and implement end-to-end MLOps pipelines using GCP, Vertex AI, Kubeflow, and Airflow.
* Automate model deployment, monitoring, retraining, logging, and ML pipeline orchestration.
* Establish and drive MLOps best practices, including version control, CI/CD, coding standards, and quality assurance.
* Optimize ML model performance, deployment processes, cloud infrastructure, and operational efficiency.
* Lead production support, troubleshoot issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive solutions.
* Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and Business teams to deploy scalable, production-ready ML solutions.
* Drive ML architecture standards, reusable design patterns, and platform improvements across the organization.
* Research and adopt emerging MLOps technologies and best practices to enhance scalability and reduce cloud costs.
* Mentor team members, promote knowledge sharing, and foster a collaborative engineering culture.
* Continuously enhance technical expertise through learning and adoption of new technologies.

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Education:**
Minimum Bachelor's degree, Advanced degree in a quantitative field (CS, engineering, statistics, math, data science).
  
  
**Experience:**
Relevant Machine Learning experience of 7+ years in MLOps and overall 12+ years of Industry experience
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL/BigQuery, and Vertex AI on GCP.
* Experience building and deploying production-scale ML models with performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience with Airflow, Kubeflow, MLflow, and MLOps orchestration.
* Knowledge of CI/CD, TDD, Jenkins, and version control tools such as Git.
* Experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) development environments.
* Strong understanding of supervised ML algorithms, data transformation, and feature engineering.
* Passion for learning new technologies and solving complex engineering problems.

**Soft Skills:**
Strong verbal and written communication skills including the ability to interact effectively with colleagues of varying technical and non-technical abilities.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* GCP Machine Learning certification, Understanding of CPG industry
* Exposure to Deep Learning/RL/LLMs
* Publications or contributions to the data science and AI community.
* Certifications in AI, machine learning, or related fields.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
  
  
Additional information
  
  
**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

That is why Third Bridge is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field

* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*

title: Data Consultant
description:

We are looking for a skilled Data Consultant with 3-5 years of experience in building and developed enterprise-grade applications. You will work within the Digital Solutions team to build scalable, secure, and high performing business applications used across major global infrastructure and environmental projects.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to support the ongoing development of digital solutions for our client’s, unlocking solutions to the world’s most critical challenges. This includes the delivery of future net zero, renewable energy, transport and water infrastructure solutions in the UK and globally. Demand for their services is higher than ever, and we need experienced people who will grow and succeed with us.
  
  
You will take a developer role in our established Digital Solutions team, working with the latest technologies, helping deliver high quality, bespoke solutions to our clients. The role is a blend of development, operations & system administration to assist in expanding the deployment of our templated solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytical solutions using SQL Server and Python, ensuring data quality, performance optimization, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Integrate, extract, transform, and model data from diverse sources including SQL databases, SharePoint, APIs, ArcGIS, and Python-based data services to support enterprise ETL and analytics requirements.
* Develop and deliver robust reporting and data solutions by collaborating with business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex requirements into actionable insights and scalable data products.

title: AI Java Lead Engineer _ Vice President _Software Engineering
description:
We're seeking someone to join our Institutional Securities Technology (Prime Brokerage AND Institutional Equity) team as a Java Backend Engineer to build scalable, high-performance enterprise applications on a team that's adopting agentic AI workflows (built on frameworks like the Claude Agent SDK). This is fundamentally a backend engineering role — the bar is deep Java/Spring Boot craftsmanship and strong problem-solving. AI/agentic experience is crucial; we need someone who is aware & can quickly pick up orchestrator/subagent patterns & eval workflows.
  
  
In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Lead Software Engineer position at Vice President Level, which is part of the job family responsible for developing and maintains software solutions that support business needs.
  
  
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
  
  
**What You’ll Do In The Role**

* 8-16 Yrs. Of Hands-on Java development.
* Deep Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, messaging integrations (Kafka, JMS, RabbitMQ).
* Strong SQL, concurrency & distributed systems design CI/CD, DevOps, production observability.
* Experience in performance tuning and scalability improvements.
* Demonstrated strong problem-solving ability and comfort learning new technologies quickly

**What You’ll Bring To The Role**

* Genuine interest in AI-assisted / agentic software development, with basic hands-on exposure (personal projects, POCs, or production) to LLM-integrated systems — e.g., calling OpenAI/Azure OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, or using tools like GitHub Copilot / Claude Code in a substantial way.
* Ability to grasp and reason about agentic concepts: orchestrator/subagent patterns, tool/function calling, eval-driven iteration ("hill climbing"), and basic prompt engineering.
* Python exposure for AI integration, scripting, or data pipeline use cases.
* Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into production backend systems (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, Spring AI, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Claude Agent SDK — including agent memory, tool calling, and multi-step reasoning loops.
* Ability to design multi-agent workflows: orchestrator/subagent patterns, agent-to-agent communication, and guardrails for autonomous systems.
* Awareness of AI system reliability concerns: hallucination mitigation, observability (tracing agent runs), latency, and cost management.
* Curiosity and self-driven experimentation with emerging agentic patterns (ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, reflection loops, human-in-the-loop gates).
* RAG architecture and Vector Database concepts.
* Financial Services or Investment Banking domain experience.
* At least 6 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role.

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Senior Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)**
The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline’s data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms.
  
  
We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production.
  
  
If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline.
  
  
**Why this job’s a big deal**
As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently.
  
  
You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams.
  
  
This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
* Architect, govern, and scale enterprise-grade Terraform module registries and infrastructure-as-code strategies for GCP data and ML platform services.
* Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI.
* Drive platform upgrades, lead capacity planning, and design operational improvements across development, QA, and production environments.
* Develop reusable automation and internal tools using Python and Shell scripting.
* Apply infrastructure-as-code, change-management, security, and auditability standards to platform changes.
* CI/CD, GitOps & Self-Service Enablement
* Define the CI/CD enterprise architecture and build governed pipelines for Airflow DAGs, Dataproc jobs, BigQuery changes, ML pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure.
* Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows.
* Set the strategy for GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, or equivalent CI/CD and GitOps tooling to improve developer experience and time to production.
* Design and engineer scalable self-service frameworks that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls.
* Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation.
* MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations
* Architect and optimize production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining.
* Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies.
* Support model gateway and LLM platform capabilities such as LiteLLM, including model onboarding, access management, rate limiting, usage visibility, cost controls, and reliability improvements.
* Define and enforce repeatable enterprise standards for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage.
* Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities.
* Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
* Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services.
* Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Participate in on-call support, lead blameless root-cause analysis (RCAs), and enforce corrective and preventative actions.
* Architect IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows.
* Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains.
* Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads.
* Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues.

**Who You Are**

* Degree & Experience: B.Tech or B.E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant.
* Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes.
* Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments.
* CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
* Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities.
* Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies.
* MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.
* Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems.
* Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations.
* Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience operating LLM gateways or GenAI platforms such as LiteLLM, Tyk, or equivalent model-access layers.
* Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems.
* Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and FinOps for data and ML workloads.
* Experience applying SRE, security, networking, or compliance practices to cloud data and ML platforms.

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
  
  
**Health & wellness coverage**
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
  
  
**Generous time off**
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
  
  
**Work/life support**
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
  
  
**Financial security programs**
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
  
  
**Additional perks & discounts**
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**
We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
**current employees**
, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.
  
  
External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

title: CONSULTANT
description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
  
  
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
  
  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
  
  
**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, and support high-quality data solutions and pipelines using modern engineering practices and tools. In this role, you will partner closely with product managers, software engineers, and data analysts to deliver scalable, reliable data capabilities that power digital products and business insights. You will be accountable for the end‑to‑end lifecycle of your data products, from design and implementation through production support, data quality, and performance against key metrics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Design, Build & Manage Data Solutions**

* Design, develop, and enhance scalable data pipelines and data processing systems.
* Build reusable ingestion, transformation, and storage patterns to support product and analytical needs.
* Integrate data from diverse sources including APIs, databases, event streams, and third‑party systems.
* Implement data models and schemas that create unified, consistent views of business operations.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Apply modern engineering practices, including version control, testing, CI/CD, and automated deployments.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and reliability through validation, monitoring, and observability tools.
* Optimize data workflows for performance, cost efficiency, and operational resilience.
* Document data flows, lineage, and technical components in support of transparency and maintainability.

**Product Collaboration & Delivery**

* Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and analysts to understand data requirements.
* Participate in iteration planning, ensuring shared understanding of backlog items and technical needs.
* Engage in daily standups, retrospectives, and product ceremonies as an active member of the team.

**Governance, Standards & Continuous Improvement**

* Contribute to data governance practices such as metadata management and data lineage.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
* Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and patterns to improve data infrastructure and engineering capabilities.
* Share knowledge and mentor less experienced engineers, contributing to team growth and best practices.

**Core Skills – All Data Engineers**

* Strong proficiency with data pipeline development in Python, Java, or Scala.
* Experience with modern data frameworks (Spark, Kafka, Flink, dbt, or equivalent).
* Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases and data modeling principles.
* Ability to optimize SQL, pipelines and storage for performance and cost.
* Experience building batch and/or streaming data solutions.
* Experience using Microsoft Fabric Notebooks to develop, debug, and operationalize data engineering workflows.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with observability and monitoring tools (Datadog preferred).
* Ability to work in collaborative, iterative, product‑centric team environments.
* Strong communication and problem‑solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with cloud data services (Azure, AWS).
* Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Semantic Models.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).
* Performance tuning for data pipelines, databases, and queries.
* Familiarity with generative and agentic AI tools to improve engineering productivity.

Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all.
  
  
Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment.
  
  
**Choose your future. Choose Atos.**

title: MSET QR Counterparty Risk Strats, Manager, Institutional Equity Division
description:

*Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.*

A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.*

From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Our broad and deep client relationships, market-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
  
  
Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Equity businesses in India. It covers functions across IED ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, Strats to risk management.

In addition to providing ad hoc analysis to support live business decisions, the team works on a wide variety of projects, including enhancing counterparty risk metrics, developing tools for collateral and resource optimization, and applying data analysis and machine learning techniques. This role, based in Mumbai, requires the individual to work with global Morgan Stanley Quantitative Research Counterparty Risk team.

title: Operations Research Engineer
description:
**Location:**
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay), Mumbai

**Job Category:**
Project Research Staff

**About the Project**

This government-funded initiative focuses on the development, integration and demonstration of drones and allied technologies. Within this programme, the role will contribute to UAV Traffic Management (UTM) research by developing methods and tools to coordinate drone operations safely and efficiently while accounting for airspace constraints and operational requirements. The project promotes research, technology development and industry-academia collaboration.

**Role Overview**

The Operations Research Scientist will build simulation-based modelling and analysis frameworks for managing traffic. The work will connect rigorous Operations Research methods with practical decision-support capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Formulate and solve optimization models for UAV routing, trajectory planning, mission scheduling, fleet/resource allocation, airspace network design and traffic-capacity planning.
* Develop strategic deconfliction and coordination algorithms for safe, efficient planning of multiple UAV operations.
* Build simulation and analytical frameworks to evaluate traffic demand, congestion, throughput, delays, resource utilization and system performance.
* Apply Operations Research methods to transportation, logistics, fleet coordination and network-management challenges.
* Analyze operational, trajectory and geospatial data to define performance metrics, conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses, and validate model outcomes.
* Translate research models into reproducible, testable software components, collaborating with software and autonomy teams and documenting technical findings.
* Bridge the gap between theoretical R&D and production-ready engineering solutions.

**Qualifications and Key Skills Required**

* PhD in a relevant discipline with relevant experience, OR MTech/ME or BTech/BE (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline with relevant research or industry experience. Relevant disciplines include Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or a closely related field.
* Strong fundamentals in optimization, mathematical modelling, algorithms, simulation modelling and quantitative analysis.
* Familiarity with optimization modelling libraries or solvers (e.g., Pyomo, OR-Tools, Gurobi or CPLEX), simulation tools (e.g., SimPy, AnyLogic or equivalent), and Monte Carlo Simulation is desirable.
* Proficiency in Python, modelling and data analysis.
* Ability to validate models, conduct sensitivity or scenario analysis, interpret results, and communicate technical findings clearly in written reports and discussions.

title: Data & AI Governance Lead
description:
**About Position:**

We are seeking an experienced Data & AI Governance Lead to drive the design, implementation, and continuous enhancement of enterprise-wide Data and AI Governance frameworks. The ideal candidate will be responsible for establishing governance operating models, ensuring data quality and stewardship practices, overseeing AI lifecycle governance, and managing AI and model risks. This role requires close collaboration with business, technology, security, privacy, compliance, legal, risk, and audit teams to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, Responsible AI principles, and industry governance standards.

* **Role: Data & AI Governance Lead**
* **Location: Mumbai**
* **Experience: Between 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**

**What You'll Do:**

* Design, implement, and continuously enhance enterprise-wide Data and AI Governance frameworks, policies, standards, and operating models.
* Establish and govern data ownership, stewardship, data quality, metadata management, data lineage, and data classification practices.
* Define and manage AI Governance processes, including AI inventory management, use-case intake, risk classification, approvals, monitoring, and reporting.
* Lead AI and model risk assessments, impact assessments, governance reviews, risk treatment plans, and approval workflows.
* Develop governance controls aligned with Responsible AI principles and regulatory requirements.

title: Quantitative Researcher
description:
WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.
  
  
WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.
  
  
Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.
  
  
**The Role:**
Research is at the core of WorldQuant. Through rigorous exploration and unconstrained thinking about how to apply data to the financial markets, our researchers are in constant search of new alphas. Researchers at WorldQuant employ tested processes seeking to identify high-quality predictive signals that we believe are undiscovered by the wider market. These signals are mathematical expressions of data that are used as inputs in our quantitative models.
  
  
WorldQuant is seeking an exceptional individual to join the firm as a Quantitative Researcher. title: Field CTO
description: Field CTO You own the technical truth of every deal you touch. Most consultancies split this into three jobs; one person pitches it, another owns the relationship, and a third inherits whatever got promised. Nobody owns the gap between what was sold, what the client needs, and what can ship. Here, you do.What are we looking forreal solver?Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind. A technical deal is won or lost long before the contract. It happens in the first conversation, where someone either finds the real problem or sells the one they were handed. If you can walk into a CTO's room, find the problem beneath the brief, and design the one answer that will hold up under the client's scrutiny and our delivery team's, we want to connect.The technical voice a CTO trusts in the first meeting.Read a proposed architecture the way a CFO reads a P&L: where the cost sits, where the risk sits, and what it takes to keep it running.Asks the question the room was avoiding.Can say "not yet" to a deal that looks signed, and is respected for it.Thinks in systems: this architecture, this baseline, this commitment, for years, not just this deal.This Isn't for Everyone. But if you've ever sat through a pre-sales demo and wondered what the system would look like on day 300, we'd love to chat with you.Your Mission: The RoleYou are the CTO our clients wish they had on speed-dial: the one person who can speak credibly for everything Searce engineers, from redesigning the process to building the system, the platform, the guardrails and the rollout. You earn a client CTO’s trust in the first meeting, elevate Searce’s engineering authority with hyper-scaler partners (Google Cloud, AWS), shape the deal around the real problem, and commit only to what the right Searce squads can deliver.Real problems never arrive sorted by service line. An agentic claims rebuild also needs a data platform, guardrails and a rollout plan. You compose that into one architecture, one baseline and one commitment. You work from first principles: find the objective before anyone names a solution, and add AI only where it removes a real bottleneck.If you have built production systems, sold them to people who could say no, and then lived with what you sold, this is your seat.Your ResponsibilitiesBe the CTO in the roomOwn the technical conversation: Lead architecture and strategy discussions with client CTOs, CIOs and engineering heads, and earn the second meeting.Diagnose before you pitch: Run discovery that separates the stated ask from the underlying objective, and name the broken process before any solution.Own the technical winBe the technical owner of the region’s deals: Own the technical side of every significant deal, from qualification to signed scope, alongside Solutions Consultants who own the hunt and the commercials. Advise on which deals to chase and which to walk away from.Compose one answer: Assemble everything Searce can build, from process redesign to platform, security and adoption, into one architecture and one baseline, so the client gets a single answer, not a stack of separate pitches.Hold the line from sold to shipped: Agree on the baseline before build, and sign off the technical baseline of every SOW with delivery leads before it goes out, so the outcome can be verified at the end.Turn proof into pipelineExecute Outcome-Driven PoCs: Architect time-boxed proof-of-value implementations tied directly to pre-agreed production KPIs and downstream delivery contracts.Show our engineering to the frontier PartnersMake Searce’s capabilities visible to partners’ executives: With the Partnerships BU, who own the relationship, lead the technical showcases for partners’ executives and field leaders: architecture reviews, live demos, reference builds and joint deal strategy. Carry the partner roadmap back in: Bring early product direction from our partners to practice leads, so the field sells what is coming, not what shipped last year.Make every deal smarter than the lastLeave reusable assets behind: Reference architectures, discovery playbooks and objection libraries, so the next field conversation starts at step four.Sharpen the solvers around you: Coach Solutions Consultants and Sales on technical selling, and feed field signals back to practice leads and Searce’s offerings.Functional SkillsExecutive Translation: Turns architecture into business consequence for a CEO, a CFO or a partners’ executives without losing a CTO’s respect.First-Principles Discovery: Separates what the client asked for from what they need.Whole-Problem Synthesis: Sees how a problem splits across process, platform, trust and adoption, and sequences the work.Commercial Judgment: Reads margin, scope risk and delivery cost well enough to say no to a bad deal.Influence Without Authority: Aligns Sales, Delivery and partners’ on one version of the truth.Structured Scoping: Converts ambiguity into bounded scope, explicit assumptions and a testable definition of done.Tech SuperpowersBuilder Roots: Hands-on engineering background. You have written, shipped and operated the systems you now design, and you can still read the code.Enterprise Cloud Architecture: Track record of designing distributed, high-throughput architectures on GCP or AWS, with deep expertise in FinOps, multi-region resiliency, and modern migration patterns. Advanced professional certifications (Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect / AWS Solutions Architect Professional) preferred.Frontier AI Ecosystem & Lab Integrations: Deep working familiarity with the frontier ecosystem, including OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, and emerging foundation model labs.Data Foundations: Has set data strategy and built platforms (lakehouse, streaming, governance) on BigQuery, Databricks or their AWS equivalents, and treats AI-ready data as a precondition, not an afterthought.Agentic AI in Production: Has shipped multi-agent systems with tool-calling, evals, guardrails and cost and latency trade-offs, beyond demos and chatbots. Tooling includes Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI), Agent Development Kit (ADK), Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, MCP and A2A protocols, RAG and vector databases, and frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI.Reliability, Security & Adoption Discipline: Has put CI/CD, test automation, SRE, observability and zero-trust security into practice at scale, and has shaped rollouts of AI into everyday work (Google Workspace, Gemini Enterprise) with working fluency, not depth.Experience & Relevance15+ years in engineering, architecture or technology leadership; B.E./B.Tech/M.S. in CS or equivalent.Has run technology as a CTO, VP Engineering, founder or equivalent, including at least one stint where you built, pivoted and scaled under real constraints.Has led architecture or technical pre-sales across more than one domain (for example platform plus AI, or security plus data), not a single lane.Has stayed through delivery on something you sold, so you know what an optimistic SOW costs.Bonus Points (you will thrive if you have)The "Builder" Bias: You have a GitHub repo, a side project, or a history of building your own tools to solve repetitive problems.Horizontal AI Experience: You’ve already tried to automate a real-world process like Claims, Invoicing, or Onboarding using AI.Startup Grit: You’ve worked in an environment where you had to wear multiple hats and solve "0→1" problems.Public Technical Presence: You’ve written blogs, spoken at meetups, or contributed to documentation in the Cloud/AI space.Join the ‘real solvers’Ready to futurify?If you are excited by the possibilities of what an AI-native, engineering-led, modern tech consultancy can do to futurify businesses, apply here and experience the ‘Art of the possible’. Don’t Just Send a Resume. Send a Statement.
